summary: Fixes library-model storage of type variables with nullable upper bounds by replacing a Map<String,Integer> (which kept only one index per class) with a SetMultimap, fixing e.g. BiConsumer.

tests.evidence: Bug fix mandates a regression test; biConsumerNullableUpperBound in JSpecifyJDKModelsTest exercises two nullable-bounded type variables on one class.

user_docs.evidence: No option or documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: CodeRabbit asked for Javadoc on typeVariablesWithNullableUpperBounds() (repo guideline); not added and the change is a small type swap.

change_description.evidence: Title and body state the bug and fix; CHANGELOG is written at release time.

performance.evidence: Map to HashMultimap at load time; no hot path change.

backward_compat.evidence: Return type of public StubxCacheUtil.getUpperBoundCache() changes from Map to SetMultimap; the class is internal to handlers and its only caller is updated.

correctness.evidence: Straightforward fix; put() and entries() semantics carry over; a glance suffices.

user_value.evidence: Bug fix, not a new feature.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Removes false positives on classes with several nullable-bounded type variables; the change users see is expected.

contradictions.evidence: No docs or comments contradicting the code.

spec_conformance.evidence: Affects how JSpecify JDK models' @Nullable upper bounds are honored; the fix just stops dropping entries.

plan.why: Tiny, cohesive bug fix; one reviewer confirming the regression test is enough.
